recipe.visualDefinition: A complex multi-layered composition featuring a central monochrome photographic subject framed by diagonal industrial hazard stripes and a background of white hand-drawn line art on a dark charcoal base.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal stripes acting as a framing device and spatial divider
High-contrast monochrome subject against a busy, illustrative background
Juxtaposition of clean geometric tape elements with raw, sketchy doodles
Muted pastel color palette clashing with industrial and punk motifs
coreInvariants: White line-art doodles on dark grey background
Paper fold and tape-like overlay textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium shot, occupying the lower-middle vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and hand gesture, framed by the intersection of diagonal stripes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the diagonal stripes from the corners toward the center, then circulate through the surrounding doodles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with 'horror vacui' style illustrations.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Charcoal grey and white (background and subject base)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cyan and lavender (diagonal stripe pattern)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red (small text and highlight markers)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation pastels paired with high-contrast black and white values.

letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent stroke weights to mimic marker or chalk
Occasional use of quotation marks as a stylistic framing device
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between raw, handwritten doodles and clean, repetitive industrial sans-serifs used in the 'tape' sections.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the DIY, punk-rock aesthetic of the background doodles
Appropriate for the industrial 'tape' text elements

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark charcoal background filled with white hand-drawn punk-style doodles (skulls, stars, barbed wire). Overlay thick diagonal stripes in alternating pale cyan and lavender with a paper-fold texture. Place a high-contrast, grainy monochrome person in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn white uppercase text in the background gaps. Add red sans-serif text in quotes along the edges of the diagonal stripes to simulate industrial labeling.

verificationChecks: Are the diagonal stripes at a consistent 45-degree angle?
Is the central subject strictly monochrome with high grain?
Do the doodles feel hand-drawn rather than clip-art?
Is the red text used sparingly as an accent?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of paper texture and creases
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not look like a standard system font
Verify the halftone/grain consistency across the subject
Confirm the color palette remains muted except for red accents
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Collage = (Monochrome Subject + Halftone Texture) + (Diagonal Pastel Stripes * Paper Crease Overlay) + (Hand-drawn White Doodles / Dark Background)
